title: Cartwise+ Membership Move from Annual to Monthly on a Pause Request
content:
A member on Cartwise+ Annual whose current annual term was opened by a plan switch from a monthly plan and who asks for a pause is moved to Cartwise+ Monthly on the day of the request, and a new one-month paid period starts that day with a plan-switch charge. A member whose annual term was opened by a first-period or renewal charge is not moved under this rule. The new monthly period is billed on its first day at the move-to-monthly charge rather than at Cartwise+ Monthly's full period fee. This move is allowed even in a term that a plan switch opened.

## When the charge is fixed

The move-to-monthly charge is fixed only after the charge that opened the annual term carries a prorated-annual refund booked against it.

The move-to-monthly charge is not fixed until the fee charge captured most recently before the annual term began carries its own refund of the value it carried into the term.

Put another way, the charge stays open for as long as the membership's entries show no prorated-annual refund against the charge that opened the annual term, or show no refund of carried value against the fee charge captured most recently before the term began.

## Scope

| Member's situation | Moved under this rule? |
|---|---|
| On Cartwise+ Annual, current term opened by a plan switch from a monthly plan, asks for a pause | yes, on the day of the request |
| On Cartwise+ Annual, current term opened by a first-period or renewal charge | no |

## Invocation: `move_annual_plan_to_monthly_dc3bc730`

This is an agent-side action: the agent unlocks `move_annual_plan_to_monthly_dc3bc730` and calls it. One call changes the membership's plan to Cartwise+ Monthly, records today as the date the plan switch took effect, opens a new one-month paid period that starts today and renews on the same day next month (the last day of that month when the day does not exist), and captures the given amount from the member's card as the plan-switch fee for that new period. The member sees the Monthly plan, the new renewal date and the plan-switch charge on the membership.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the Cartwise+ membership being moved, read from the membership lookup | identifier |
| `amount_usd` | the plan-switch fee captured for the new monthly period | USD, a non-negative number with 2 decimal places; more digits are rounded to the nearest cent |

**Return.** On success the tool returns a receipt with `charge_id` (the new fee charge entry's reference number), `membership_id`, `variant_name` (always "Cartwise+ Monthly"), `plan_switched_date` (today), `current_period_start` (today), `current_period_end` (the new renewal date), `amount_usd` (as captured, 2 decimal places) and `status` of `switched`, meaning the membership now stands on Cartwise+ Monthly with the charge captured. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. The tool defines no error return.

## Hypothetical renewal dates

| Moved on | New renewal date |
|---|---|
| 14 March | 14 April |
| 31 May | 30 June |
